scene.note: The whiteboard becomes one list that your functions read by position, cut, and change in place.

steps.note: Rhona phones from the top of the list, and the newest member is at the bottom.
Positions count from 0 at the start, and from -1 at the end, whatever the length.
The first and the last name come back, one name each.
A callout needs a hill party of a given size, taken from the top of the list.
A slice cuts the first names out as a new list, and a short list just gives all it has.
The hill party goes up, and the whiteboard stays as it was.
A new member signs up at the base.
First ask whether the name is on the list already.
If it is not, the name goes on at the bottom of the same list, and nothing comes back.
Tonight's leader is somewhere on the list.
The leader comes out of their place, and goes back in at the top.
Everyone else keeps their order on the same list.
Rhona is ready to phone the next person.
The top name comes off the list, so the list is one shorter.
That name comes back to be paged. An empty list gives back nothing to page.
